correctness.rationale: The independent record increments have an exact geometric-excursion renewal law in both geometries. Solving the killed/reflected discrete Dirichlet equation yields E[e^{-s S_m/n}] as a product of 1+c_n tanh(theta_n)tanh(kappa i theta_n) factors. Hyperbolic-tangent deficit sum O(1/theta_n), together with the quadratic logarithm error, yields inverse hitting-time Laplace limits e^{-r s-gamma r sqrt(2s)} and e^{-r sqrt(2s)}. Laplace uniqueness, the exact monotone inversion identity, and the Brownian reflection principle give the asserted CDFs including endpoints. The only needed sequences are c_n sqrt(n)→gamma finite or c_n→0 and c_n sqrt(n)→infinity. The standalone checker passed 584 exact-rational finite-state assertions and 24 numerical convergence checks, distinct from the analytic infinite proof.

value.rationale: The natural question is the rate at which weakening the previously-traversed edge preference changes the range from order n to order sqrt(n)/c_n. The result gives an exact intermediate probability law and determines the threshold n^-1/2, plus geometry-independent limits even though the fixed-weight full-line and half-line moment constants differ. This is substantive distributional structure for a natural model, not an arbitrary parameter slice or an exercise in evaluating a known table.
